item.title: Liquid AI Ships 4-Bit Quantized Models Claiming 97% of BF16 Quality
item.summary: Liquid AI released 4-bit quantized checkpoints for its LFM2.5 model family using Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD), claiming approximately 97% of BF16 quality retention — a self-reported figure that, if validated, could significantly lower the hardware barrier for on-device agent deployment.
